heading.en: What practitioners say about Org Topologies
heading.text: O que os praticantes dizem sobre Org Topologies

items.2.quote.en: “We did this as a team exercise last week, gauging where on the map the teams thought they were. And then with Org Topologies, we were able to share our vision on where we want to go next. The great thing is that this helped us stay away from good/bad discussions and focus on something as simple as ‘we are here’ and ‘this is where we want to go next’.”
items.2.quote.text: “Fizemos isso como exercício de equipe na semana passada, vendo onde no mapa as equipes achavam que estavam. Depois, com Org Topologies, conseguimos compartilhar a nossa visão de para onde queremos ir. O ótimo é que isso nos ajudou a fugir de discussões de bom/ruim e a focar em algo tão simples quanto ‘estamos aqui’ e ‘é para lá que queremos ir’.”
